mistakes.name: said the sounds but they stayed apart

learner_words: It was okay. The dinosaur ones were kind of funny. I kept saying the sounds right but I couldn't make them stick together into a word. Like I knew the sounds but my brain wouldn't blend them.
guide_note: Wasn't in the room for this one. Ash did it independently after lunch — seemed in an okay mood when I checked in after. Looked at the stats: 8 out of 11, made it to level 2. The game flagged that the sounds weren't blending. Ash's own description actually matched that pretty well.
